environment: jsdom with real Nav, Hero, Contact and both providers; verifies state/semantics, not visual layout

results.name: Default is midnight, with accessible icon-only language and appearance buttons
A theme change preserves typed contact data, focus and the current URL
Saved light is applied before hydration and is not overwritten by a default dark write
Arabic/English switching keeps the active theme and both controls remain usable
Mobile-menu state survives an appearance switch and the localized links remain present
Cross-tab preference changes synchronize; unrelated storage changes do not change appearance
Invalid or cleared preferences safely return to the configured dark default
Blocked storage does not break initial render, language switching or theme toggling
